style_table.label: Detail
style_table.summary: Careful, analytical and quality-minded; likes to get things right.

rows.strength: Sets high standards and leads through expertise.
rows.limitation: Can over-control the details of others' work.

rows.strength: Breaks goals into precise, checkable steps.
rows.limitation: Can plan for longer than needed before starting.

rows.strength: Finds elegant solutions through deep analysis.
rows.limitation: May reject ideas that are not yet fully worked out.

rows.strength: Gives clear specifications and quality criteria.
rows.limitation: Finds it hard to accept 'good enough'.

rows.strength: Accurate, well-reasoned and well-prepared.
rows.limitation: Can come across as reserved or overly technical.

rows.strength: Weighs evidence thoroughly and avoids careless errors.
rows.limitation: Can stall waiting for certainty.

style_table.label: Results
style_table.summary: Moves things forward, enjoys a challenge and measures progress by outcomes.

rows.strength: Gives clear direction and keeps momentum when a goal is in sight.
rows.limitation: Can push pace harder than the team can sustain.

rows.strength: Sets stretching, concrete targets and owns them.
rows.limitation: May skip agreeing the target with others first.

rows.strength: Generates bold options when the usual route is blocked.
rows.limitation: Drops ideas quickly if they do not pay off fast.

rows.strength: Hands over whole outcomes rather than single tasks.
rows.limitation: Takes work back when others seem slow.

rows.strength: Direct and to the point; people know where they stand.
rows.limitation: Can sound abrupt; may not check how a message landed.

rows.strength: Decides quickly with incomplete information.
rows.limitation: Can commit before the facts that matter are in.

style_table.label: Paced
style_table.summary: Steady, patient and dependable; values consistency and cooperation.

rows.strength: Builds trust and a calm, reliable team rhythm.
rows.limitation: May hold back from stepping forward when a change is needed.

rows.strength: Sets realistic goals and sticks with them over time.
rows.limitation: Can under-stretch to avoid disruption.

rows.strength: Improves existing processes patiently and practically.
rows.limitation: Slower to embrace radical change.

rows.strength: Supports others and checks in kindly.
rows.limitation: May keep work to avoid burdening others.

rows.strength: A good listener who makes others feel heard.
rows.limitation: May not voice disagreement until late.

rows.strength: Considers the impact on everyone involved.
rows.limitation: Needs time; can delay under pressure to decide fast.

rows.strength: Creates enthusiasm and a sense of belonging in a group.
rows.limitation: May avoid hard conversations to keep the mood positive.

rows.strength: Makes goals feel shared and worth chasing.
rows.limitation: Goals can stay inspiring but vague.

rows.strength: Builds on others' ideas and connects people who should meet.
rows.limitation: Can chase the newest idea before finishing the last.

rows.strength: Matches tasks to people's interests and motivates them.
rows.limitation: Follow-up on details can slip.

rows.strength: Warm, expressive and good at reading the room.
rows.limitation: May talk through a point when listening would help more.

rows.strength: Brings people along so decisions stick.
rows.limitation: Can be swayed by the most recent or most liked voice.
